info.title: Partiful remote API contract
info.description: Single source of truth for Partiful remote calls and wire shapes. Partiful has no public API. Each operation records dated provenance in x-evidence; unobserved responses remain unknown. Evidence status observed includes inspected first-party assets and official protocols, not just live traffic; the source note distinguishes them.

200.description: Official Firestore list-documents envelope. The host guest fallback has only an empty-list live observation reported in PR #249; populated guest field mappings are inferred from getGuests and remain unverified. Unknown document shapes fail closed. Blast preconditions read only status and checkIn.

default.description: Response status and body are unknown.

x-evidence.source: Official Firestore list protocol: docs/research/2026-08-10-contract-evidence-sources.md#official-firestore-rest-protocol. Collection path and client preconditions: docs/research/2026-08-12-text-blast-mapping-public-assets.md#host-only-precondition-reads. Public-asset research only; no live collection request or mutation. Pagination limits, authorization, and unobserved failures unknown. PR #249 reports a live empty host list on 2026-09-29 after getGuests returned HTTP 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION / User is host. Populated host guest fields name, status, count, userId, and anchorGuestId are inferred from the callable guest projection, not a populated Firestore observation; require real Partiful evidence. Document ID comes from the Firestore document name. The CLI bounds traversal to 10 pages of pageSize=1000 and 10000 documents, rejecting repeated tokens or overflow without partial results. These are local safety caps; Firestore documents no maximum collection size.
